summary: Reviews password-authenticated key agreement (PAKE) schemes, which let two parties use a weak shared password to authenticate each other and derive strong cryptographic keys. It describes the different kinds of schemes and gives requirements and recommendations for designers of new ones. It is a product of the Crypto Forum Research Group.

eli5.summary: Two friends share a short secret word. A PAKE lets them prove they both know it and make a much stronger secret code, without anyone listening in learning the word.
